title: camp utility listing
description: A pointer-only listing for an ecosystem tool that is not a Moodle plugin (camp-docs#4): no component, no version.php, no release ledger, nothing hosted or verified. The entry records the tool's canonical home and basic facts; enrich keeps the metrics current. Admission requires a public repository for claims anchoring and a machine-monitorable distribution channel (the source host, or a declared release-channel whose scheme camp-tools implements).

name.description: The listing slug: filename, URL path, and primary key. Its own first-come namespace, fully separate from frankenstyle components (NAMESPACE.md).

display-name.description: Human name shown on pages; the slug renders when absent.

category.description: What kind of tool this is; the vocabulary grows by registry decision alongside the site's display names.

source.description: The public repository anchoring claims and issue reporting. For an open tool this is the source repository; for a closed-source tool it may be the project's docs/issue-tracker repository, and the site labels it accordingly.

source-repo-id.description: The platform's permanent numeric repository id, the claims identity anchor — same semantics as plugin entries.

install.description: How users obtain the tool, upstream; the registry hosts nothing.

release-channel.description: Off-repo distribution channel as "scheme:ref" (e.g. openvsx:LMSCloud/mdlcode). The scheme must be one camp-tools implements — the adapter table is the admission fence. Required when the source host is not one enrich monitors natively.

license.description: SPDX identifier, or the word Proprietary for closed-source tools.

closed-source.description: The tool's source code is not published. The site renders full disclosure: a Closed source pill, the repository row labeled as project (not source) repository, and no repository metrics.

claimed.description: Date the maintainer claimed the listing (set by the claim PR, with the same repo-control proof as plugin claims). Absent on curated-only entries.

metrics.description: Enrich-maintained; hand edits are overwritten by the next sweep.
